name: @aether/service-ai-orchestrator
displayName: AI Tool Orchestrator (Free-First, Billing-Aware Model Routing)
description: Every AI capability — product recommendations, image processing, data analysis, data cleaning, reporting, assistant turns — routed by CONFIG, never code. Priority policy: always-free providers first; paid models unlock ONLY for paying customers (billing-tier entitlement); per-task / per-tenant / per-customer routing directives are bitemporal decision-table rules from the pack. Budget guards (degrade-to-free or reject), fallback chains on rate limits, cost estimation, markup-based tenant billing with platform absorption for free users, BYOK credential references (KMS pointers, never keys). Swap providers, prices, policies, tiers — pack epoch, zero code. Plugs into any host via injected model adapters.
